answer_text: Azure IPsec with Azure can differ from other providers, and PFS/DH group mismatches are a common cause of rekey failures. The DH group must match on both sides for the IPsec SA to be established and rekeyed; ensure the DH group configured in the Cato Management Application matches Azure’s expected value. In short, verify and align your DH/PFS settings between Cato and Azure to explain and resolve the rekey failure.
